## [0.26.0] - 2026-09-04

The **platform floor release** for macOS. Vayu moves to Electron 44 (Chromium 152, Node 24.18), which raises the minimum macOS version and brings a Chromium and Node jump to the renderer and the main process.

### Added

- **System notifications for what finishes while you are somewhere else.** A load or collection run reaching its end, the engine dropping out, an update becoming ready, and a sign-in completing in your browser can now reach you as an operating-system notification instead of a toast you find on your way back. Off by default, in Settings > Notifications; nothing is posted while Vayu is the window in front, because the toast has already said it. The body carries the run's own numbers - "12,400 requests, p95 210 ms, 0.3% errors" - and clicking it brings Vayu forward on that run. Everything else the app reports stays a toast.

### Changed

- **Vayu's application identifier is now `io.github.athrvk.vayu`.** It was `com.vayu.client`, which claimed a domain the project does not own. The identifier is what macOS keys an app's preferences, caches and saved state by, so **macOS may ask again for permissions you had already granted**, and preferences stored by an earlier version are not read by this one. Windows installs upgrade in place as usual - the installer keeps its previous identity deliberately, so this release does not appear twice in Add/Remove Programs. `install.sh --uninstall --purge` removes both the old and the new locations.
- **macOS 13 (Ventura) or later is now required.** Electron 44 dropped support for macOS 12, so the universal DMG and zip this release publishes will not launch on it. Windows and Linux are unaffected; the Linux AppImage stays x86_64 and the Windows installer stays x64, as before - Electron's removal of 32-bit Windows and Linux ARMv7 builds costs Vayu nothing, because it never shipped either.
- **The window has rounded corners on Linux.** Electron 43 made frameless windows rounded by default there, which is the shape Vayu's own titlebar already implies and the one macOS has always drawn. The app now states the shape explicitly rather than inheriting it, so a future Electron default cannot move it.
